source.name: MASSIVE 1.1
source.citation: FitzGerald et al., "MASSIVE: A 1M-Example Multilingual Natural Language Understanding Dataset with 51 Typologically-Diverse Languages", 2022
source.sampling: 600 of 2974 test utterances, proportional to scenario, seed 42; identical ids across locales

task.name: scenario
task.instructions: Classify this voice-assistant request into the scenario it belongs to.

criteria.alarm: Setting, checking or removing alarms and wake-up calls.
criteria.audio: Controlling the assistant's sound volume: mute, louder, quieter.
criteria.calendar: Creating, checking or deleting calendar events, meetings and reminders.
criteria.datetime: Asking the current time or date, or converting between time zones.
criteria.email: Reading, sending or searching emails; managing email contacts.
criteria.general: Chit-chat, greetings, jokes, and replies to the assistant (yes, no, stop, repeat, thanks) with no task.
criteria.iot: Smart-home devices: lights, plugs, coffee machine, vacuum cleaner.
criteria.lists: Creating, adding to, reading or removing items from lists (shopping, to-do).
criteria.music: Music preferences and settings: liking or disliking a song, asking what is playing, playback settings.
criteria.play: Starting playback of music, radio, podcasts, audiobooks or games.
criteria.qa: Factual questions: definitions, facts, maths, stock prices, currency rates.
criteria.recommendation: Recommendations for events, movies, restaurants or places.
criteria.social: Social media: posting an update or checking feeds and notifications.
criteria.takeaway: Ordering takeaway food or checking a food order.
criteria.transport: Trains, buses, taxis and traffic: timetables, tickets, rides, traffic conditions.
